top_signals.title: Stocks Rise as Nvidia Tempers AI Fears: Markets Wrap

top_signals.title: Fracking Giants Tapped to Drill Gas Project in Western Australia
top_signals.summary: Perth-based Black Mountain Energy has selected fracking services giants to drill initial appraisal wells in one of the biggest unconventional gas basins in Western Australia. Black Mountain Energy on Wednesday said it had tendered and selected the major service companies that will play a major role in drilling the initial appraisal wells in Project Valhalla, which the firm says is one of the largest undeveloped gas reservoirs in the world.
